concept_name: least squares cost for incomplete data
aliases: least squares cost for incomplete data
profile: least squares cost for incomplete data: a cost function for incomplete data, defined as g(w1,...,wP, C) = 1/P ∑_p ||{C w_p - x_p}|_{Ω_p}||^2. It minimizes the least squares cost only over the entries indexed by Ω_p, rather than over all entries. The expression {C w_p - x_p}|_{Ω_p} restricts the residual to the components in Ω_p for each data point p.
